summary_1line: Jamadagni spares the sun after Surya supplicates him, leading to the origin and religious merit of gifting umbrellas and sandals.

image_candidates.scene_text: At blazing midday, the sage Jamadagni stands with bow drawn, aiming an arrow at the radiant sun in the sky.
Surya disguised as a humble Brahmana bows with folded hands before the fiery sage Jamadagni.
The sun-god presents an umbrella and a pair of sandals to the sage as gifts to protect people from the sun’s heat.
